== English errata comparison sources ==
The Decipher Glossary limits the search to once during each of your turns and rewrites the Reserve Deck and reshuffle terminology. The deployment, Carbon-Freezing destiny bonus, one-Force cost and three named targets are retained.

Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=33|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 33. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 6. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=6|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 6. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=106|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 106. [[:File:CC-D-carbonitechamberconsole.gif|Complete replacement face]].
